description: All 34 Sharma-Wu-Dalal test pairs. These exist because CIEDE2000 has two failure modes that produce PLAUSIBLE results: the hue-difference discontinuity at +/-180 degrees, and a sign-wrong Rt term. An implementation that does not reproduce these is wrong regardless of how it reads. Tolerance is 5e-5 throughout because the published values are quoted to four decimal places; our worst deviation is 4.95e-5, which is that rounding and not slack. Every pair is ALSO computed independently by culori in the test, so a transcription error in any of the seven numbers per row is caught separately from an implementation error.
